notes: The physical line count is 19 main rows, including the numbered display as line 14. Interlinear insertions, the head number and the lower foliation are inventoried separately.

Source claim, lines 1–3: the author says that the quoted forage de trous must provide a groupe extérieur Π_{0,3}(I); the raised addition gives the written type (0,3+card I), and the prose says Γ acts on it.

Source wording, lines 3–8: the qualification il vaut mieux peut-être and the unresolved peut|pourra are preserved. The source refers to yoga introduit par ailleurs des groupoïdes rigides and then to boucher certains des trous 0,1,∞. No name is supplied in place of ailleurs.

Source description, lines 8–13: the author writes an équivalent groupoïdal de la droite projective, calls it la sphère arithmétique and describes a groupe à lacets infini. These are statements of the manuscript; no proof or mathematical comparison was carried out.

Source definition, display (6) and lines 15–16: the displayed K_1 equality is retained with its canceled variable before T_1. The following prose calls it the extension transcendante pure, with the raised abbreviation typ., de degré 1 de Q. The abbreviation is not expanded in the transcription.

Source continuation, lines 17–19: the author starts from (6), writes the abbreviated de overlined-m, and continues through the groupoidal equivalent and et on remonte comme. The page ends at comme; nothing is supplied after it.
The opening parenthesis after Γ opère in line 3 remains unbalanced on this leaf. The canceled quotation fragment also receives no supplied closing quotation mark.
